title: Every finite separable residue extension is realized by an etale neighbourhood
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Given a scheme S, a point s, and a finite separable extension k of the residue field kappa(s), there exists an etale neighbourhood (U, u) -> (S, s) whose residue extension kappa(u)/kappa(s) is isomorphic to k. The retained proof states the reduction: we may assume S affine, in which case the claim is Algebra, lemma-make-etale-map-prescribed-residue-field. Retained author proof at lines 10147-10151.
